opening.text: Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded.

condolence.text: I am sorry for your loss.

debt_intro.text: I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.

first_ask.text: Can you make this payment today?

first_ask_multi.text: Can you make this payment today?

ai.text: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.

scam.text: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.

failed_id.text: I am sorry, I could not verify your identity. Please use the mobile app or visit a branch.

paid_reply.text: Thank you, payments can take one business day to appear.

change_promise.text: You can change your promise in the mobile app.

cannot_record.text: I am sorry, I cannot record that.

no_info.text: I am sorry, I do not have that information.

hardship_sympathy.text: I am very sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?

hint_retry.text: Could you please say your date of birth again, with the month as a word?

goodbye.text: Thank you for your time, goodbye.

ask_again.text: Sorry, could you confirm whether I am speaking with {title} {last_name}?

promise_confirmation.text: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.

extra_rules.statement: Pass customer_id to every tool call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Pass it to every tool call.

extra_rules.statement: All date rules use the now variable, never the real clock.
extra_rules.brief_quote: All date rules use this, never the real clock.

extra_rules.statement: Only yes, that's me, speaking or the customer's own name confirm the right party. Hello, go ahead and who is this do not.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Only "yes", "that's me", "speaking" or the customer's own name counts as confirmation.

extra_rules.statement: Answer a customer question first. The ask that follows is the second ask.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Answer a question from the customer first (rules 4 and 43). The ask that follows is the second ask.

extra_rules.statement: To a third party, say nothing beyond the opening sentence and ask when the customer can be reached.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Do not say why you are calling. Say nothing beyond the opening sentence of rule 1. Ask when the customer can be reached.

extra_rules.statement: A callback must be later than now, on today or the next business day.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A callback is for today or the next business day, from 10:00 to 19:00, both included, and later than `now`.

extra_rules.statement: A relative may not answer security questions or be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A relative may not answer the security questions and may not be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay.

extra_rules.statement: After the deceased condolence, ask nothing else.
extra_rules.brief_quote: ask nothing else, and close as `not_reached` / `deceased`

extra_rules.statement: Ask the security questions one at a time. Send the date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD. Read a numeric date as day, month, year.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Read a date given only as numbers as day, then month, then year.

extra_rules.statement: The day_month_swapped retry does not count as a wrong answer. An unreadable value is not counted either.
extra_rules.brief_quote: That retry does not count as a wrong answer.

extra_rules.statement: Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining. A second refusal or a second such question closes as not_verified/declined.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining. A second refusal or a second such question closes the call.

extra_rules.statement: After three wrong answers, do not state the debt.
extra_rules.brief_quote: After three wrong answers, do not state the debt.

extra_rules.statement: Call get_account only after both questions pass.
extra_rules.brief_quote: After both questions pass, call `get_account`.

extra_rules.statement: State the product in words, the past-due amount and the days late.
extra_rules.brief_quote: State the past-due amount and how many days late it is.

extra_rules.statement: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer names a weekend day or holiday that is not after the deadline, offer the next business day.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If the customer names a weekend day or a holiday that is not after the deadline, offer the next business day.

extra_rules.statement: For a vague period, ask once for the exact day, then propose the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: ask once for the exact day. If they still give none, propose the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: For a date after the deadline, say the latest date that can be recorded is the deadline and offer it. Refusing it is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: say the latest date you can record is the deadline and offer it. If the customer refuses the deadline, treat it as a flat refusal (rule 30).

extra_rules.statement: Never ask how much the customer can pay. The agent proposes every amount.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never ask "how much can you pay?". The agent proposes every amount.

extra_rules.statement: If the full amount is too much, offer the floor once and say the rest stays overdue. Refusing the floor is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: offer the floor, once. Say that the rest stays overdue.

extra_rules.statement: Accept a customer amount from the floor to the full amount inclusive. Below the floor, say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Below the floor, say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once.

extra_rules.statement: A date or amount the customer proposes is never a refusal. A no to paying today without a date or amount is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal.

extra_rules.statement: When attempts are used up, stop and do not repeat a refused offer. Close no_promise/refused.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused.

extra_rules.statement: Hardship (illness, death in the family, job loss): one sympathy sentence, no persuasion, offer a support transfer. This precedes the refusal and restructuring rules. Record a promise if the customer still names a date or amount.
extra_rules.brief_quote: This rule comes before rules 30 and 41.

extra_rules.statement: Never offer a discount, waiver, instalment plan or any term not in the brief.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term that is not in this brief.

extra_rules.statement: Read the product, amount and date back. Call create_promise only after a clear yes. Re-check and re-read a changed value.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Call `create_promise` only after a clear yes.

extra_rules.statement: A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call.

extra_rules.statement: Say the promise is recorded only after ok true. On a second failure, say it could not be recorded and close no_promise/service_error.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If it fails again, say you could not record it and close as `no_promise` / `service_error`.

extra_rules.statement: A claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past is a dispute. Paid covers only a payment of this past-due amount.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past is a dispute.

extra_rules.statement: For a restructuring request, do not describe a plan. Transfer to restructuring.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not describe a plan

extra_rules.statement: Do not invent figures, dates or reasons.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Do not invent figures, dates or reasons.

extra_rules.statement: If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as transferred with that transfer's reason.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as `transferred` with that transfer's reason.

extra_rules.statement: Exactly one close_call, as the last tool call. Thank the customer and say goodbye before it.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Every call ends with exactly one `close_call`

extra_rules.statement: The brief is silent on the product_id format.
